html:
Mario Vargas Llosa was a Peruvian novelist and essayist, one of the leading writers of the Latin American Boom of the 1960s. He won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2010.

Born in Arequipa, he made his name with The Time of the Hero (1963), about a military school in Lima, which the school burned in public. Novels such as Conversation in the Cathedral and The Feast of the Goat explored power, corruption and dictatorship across Latin America. He was a friend and then a rival of García Márquez; in 1976 he punched him in a Mexico City cinema.

Once a supporter of the Cuban revolution, he became a free-market liberal. He ran for president of Peru in 1990 and lost to Alberto Fujimori. He took Spanish citizenship in 1993 and died in Lima in 2025.
sum: Mario Vargas Llosa was a Peruvian novelist and essayist, one of the leading writers of the Latin American Boom of the 1960s. He won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2010.
